brief.headline: Push for a ₹250/kg price — our current ₹1067.36/kg is 326.9% above the best price we pay anywhere, and the open market trades pharma-grade laminate at ₹250/kg.

priceAsk.summary: Ask for ₹250/kg on laminate, matching the best price we pay and the typical open-market level.
priceAsk.basis: We're paying ₹1067.36/kg to Huhtamaki, while Silk Polypack supplies us the same material at ₹250/kg. The open market ask for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typically ₹250/kg — so ₹250 is market-fair. Our current price is 326.9% above that.

brief.financialLeverage: Huhtamaki keeps about ₹5 of every ₹100 they sell and carries very little debt (0.11x). They're growing fast — 23.1% a year — so they want new orders. But we're tiny: our ₹76850 is 0.00% of their ₹2755.75 Cr revenue, so on our own we have almost no pull. The play is to name the market price (₹250/kg), show them we have it elsewhere, and offer to commit more volume or a longer term in exchange for matching it — they need volume to feed that growth.

evidence.point: Our laminate price is 326.9% above the best price we pay anywhere
Open-market ask for pharma/ORS sachet laminate is ₹205–305/kg, typically ₹250/kg
Dropping to ₹250/kg saves us ₹58850 a year
We are 0.00% of their ₹2755.75 Cr revenue — tiny customer

alternates.name: UFLEX Ltd
alternates.why: Listed flexibles giant — both film substrate AND conversion; can second-source laminate at scale (₹16492.00 Cr revenue, C health score 46/100).

alternates.name: Constantia Parikh Packaging Pvt Ltd
alternates.why: Global Constantia group's India converter — pharma blister/sachet laminates; strong second-source for laminate (₹222.04 Cr revenue, D health score 31/100).

risks: We spend only ₹76850 with them — 0.00% of their sales — so they may not care about our business unless we bundle more volume or commit longer term.
Silk Polypack gives us ₹250/kg today, so if Huhtamaki won't move we can walk — but check Silk's capacity and quality before we go all-in.
Huhtamaki's health score is C (58/100) — not distressed, but not strong — so if we squeeze too hard they may just drop us rather than take a thin-margin order.
brief.suggestedOpeningLine: We're paying you ₹1067 a kilo for laminate, but the market price is around ₹250 and we're already buying at ₹250 from another supplier — let's talk about how we can get there with you, because we'd like to grow this business together.
